**Analyzing Block Configurations**

I'm focusing on the configurations of the blocks, specifically their initial positions and how the upper block interacts with the lower one. The thickness of each block is a critical factor, with the upper always being 1 unit thick and the lower being 2 or more. The "fall" of the upper block is also key, as it moves downward until it makes contact with the lower block. Right now I'm paying close attention to the color value.
